subtitle: 탄돌 교각 앞 /인사 한 번의 무게

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
탄돌 교각 침낭퀘
하러 온 호드 쪼렙이네.
오늘은 그냥 봐줄까.
cuts.visual_prompt: Agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. High-angle side shot of the dwarf hunter sitting relaxed on a small stone bridge ledge on the left with her wooden blunderbuss strapped securely on her back and her wolf pet resting beside her. She rests her chin on one hand with an amused smirk while looking down toward a tiny distant stone path at the bottom right. Minimal stone ledge floor touch beneath her boots.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
안녕 쪼렙들~
얼른 침낭퀘 하고 가!
(/인사)
cuts.visual_prompt: Agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Medium wide side-view shot on a minimal stone bridge path: on the left, the dwarf hunter stands cheerfully waving her hand high with a bright friendly grin and her blunderbuss strapped on her back, while her wolf pet wags its tail. On the right, the low-level orc warrior in modest starter armor walks past carrying a rolled warm beige-brown medieval adventurer quilted wool sleeping bag with leather straps slung over her shoulder.

cuts.speaker: 오크 전사
cuts.dialogue:
얼라 고렙이 손 흔드네.
괜히 말 섞지 말고
그냥 씹고 가자.
cuts.visual_prompt: Agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Low-angle three-quarter rear-side shot of the orc warrior on the left and the undead paladin on the right briskly walking forward without looking back. Both lowbies carry rolled warm beige-brown quilted wool sleeping bags with leather straps on their backs; the orc warrior gives a dismissive side glance while the undead paladin stares straight ahead with deadpan boredom. Minimal stone path shadow under their feet.

Agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dramatic tight close-up Dutch-angle shot centered on the dwarf hunter frozen mid-wave, her friendly smile completely erased into cold narrowed eyes and a twitching brow under a dark comic forehead shadow. Her wolf pet beside her also freezes with wide shocked eyes as the hunter's other hand slowly reaches behind her shoulder toward her wooden blunderbuss. No text or speech bubbles.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
인사만 받아줬어도
무사히 침낭퀘 하고
지나갔을 거다.
cuts.visual_prompt: Agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Dynamic over-the-shoulder shot from behind the dwarf hunter on the left aiming her wooden blunderbuss directly at the panicked orc warrior on the right. A glowing red Hunter's Mark arrow icon hovers above the orc warrior's head as she freezes in terror clutching her rolled beige-brown wool sleeping bag, while the hunter's wolf lunges forward snarling. Minimal bridge shadow lines at their feet.

cuts.speaker: 드워프 사냥꾼
cuts.dialogue:
근데 인사를 안 받아줬잖아?
잘 가라, 쪼렙들!
(/인사)
cuts.visual_prompt: Agile 3-to-3.5 head-to-body Korean gag webtoon style on a 100% pure solid white #FFFFFF background. Wide comedic aftermath shot: on the left, the dwarf hunter stands smugly with her blunderbuss strapped back on her shoulder, waving goodbye cheerfully with a sweet closed-eye smile while her wolf sits proudly beside her. On the right, the defeated orc warrior lies comically flat face-down on the minimal bridge floor with dizzy swirl eyes beside a dropped rolled beige-brown wool sleeping bag and a cute non-gore cartoon gravestone marker.
